title: Reed Jobs Scraper
description: Scrape jobs from Reed.co.uk listings. Provide keyword/location or a Reed search URL. Actor paginates and optionally scrapes detail pages.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Job search keyword(s). Example: Software Developer

results_wanted.title: Max jobs
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of jobs to collect. Leave empty to collect all.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap on listing pages to visit.

collectDetails.title: Collect job details
collectDetails.description: If enabled, scraper opens job detail pages for full description/salary.

cookies.title: Custom cookies (raw header)
cookies.description: Optional raw Cookie header string. Helps bypass consent/guest banners.

cookiesJson.title: Custom cookies (JSON)
cookiesJson.description: Optional JSON cookies. Accepts array (e.g., ["a=1", {"name":"b","value":"2"}]) or object map (e.g., {"a":"1","b":"2"}).
